matchups.preview: Up next: Supernova Takeover and Newman’s Owen. Supernova Takeover and Newman’s Owen have met 2 times in the regular season, with Supernova Takeover averaging 151.81 points to Newman’s Owen's 160.27. Jamie, Pat, Mark, Owen, Mikey (likely Mikey G), and TJ all attended Drexel together for college. At TE, Supernova Takeover is projected to outscore Newman’s Owen by roughly 7.1 points. You might know Newman’s Owen better as the charitable salad dressings.

Chig-a-Doodle-Doo takes on ROK Navy's Finest in one of the tightest projected games of the week. Flip a coin, honestly. They're dead even at 1-1 across 2 meetings -- no edge either way, historically. ROK Navy's Finest projects for a real edge at TE this week -- about 2.3 points clear of Chig-a-Doodle-Doo there. Their highest-scoring meeting ever came in 2025 Week 4, when they combined for 296.74 points.

theMadgician walks in as a 79% favorite here -- Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 is going to need the upset, not the odds. theMadgician has won 2 straight in this series. theMadgician projects for a real edge at TE this week -- about 2.8 points clear of Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 there. Back in 2025 Week 12, these two combined for 240.78 points -- still their high-water mark against each other.

This week's slate includes Big Dumb Sports vs. Jake From State Farm. Jake From State Farm holds a 6-4 career edge over Big Dumb Sports in the regular season. Pat, Jamie, Nick, Mark, Anthony (Acap), Kodi, Dennis, and TJ all attended Delsea together for high school. The numbers favor Big Dumb Sports at RB by about 5.9 points this week -- worth a lineup check if you're Jake From State Farm. If you want offense, check the archives: 2025 Week 5 saw this pair put up 338.56 points between them.

Supernovas and Bandits is as close to a coin flip as the power scores get this week. Bandits holds a 6-5 career edge over Supernovas in the regular season. The last playoff meeting between these two (2024 semifinal) went to Bandits. If you want offense, check the archives: 2023 Week 8 saw this pair put up 324.74 points between them.

This week's slate includes packerlove24 vs. VRDNO. packerlove24 has won 2 straight in this series. Back in 2025 Week 4, these two combined for 314.16 points -- still their high-water mark against each other. At RB, packerlove24 is projected to outscore VRDNO by roughly 6.7 points.
